mentions.name: LngBrdg
mentions.description: A Chrome extension that helps professionals write and translate emails in 100+ languages directly inside the browser, aiming to preserve tone and clarity better than existing translation tools.
mentions.problem: Existing translation tools couldn't handle tone or clarity well when writing professional emails.
mentions.audience: Professionals who need to write and translate emails in many languages.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m working on LngBrdg, a Chrome extension that helps professionals write and translate emails in 100+ languages — right inside their browser.
